name: HiBench
description: The first benchmark framework designed to systematically evaluate hierarchical structure reasoning capabilities of large language models across 30 tasks and six scenarios, covering fundamental and practical aspects with 39,519 queries.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for hierarchical reasoning in LLMs; promising but not yet broadly established as a community standard.
notes: Includes a small instruction dataset that significantly improves LLM performance on hierarchical reasoning tasks.
